note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 135; the original is in English. The original figures for the head width including the eyes, the mandible length, the postclypeal length and the long ocellar diameter contain OCR damage (e.g. “0.7S”, “0.SO”, “0.lS”, “0.OS”) and are not recorded. The worker is dimorphic and is combined in a single section. The synonym list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule deep straw yellow, antennae and body yellowish white, paler than the head; mandibles reddish brown, deep straw yellow at the base. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length about 3.5–4.0 mm. Head capsule rectangular to oval, rather thick, maximum width 0.65–0.75, height 0.50–0.60 mm; frontal projection weak, the frontal surface steeply sloping forwards. Fontanelle distinct, at the beginning of the slope of the frontal surface, the distance from the occiput to the fontanelle 0.60–0.75 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2 and subequal to or slightly longer than segment 4; segment 5 longer and wider than segment 4. Labrum short, subsquare, the apex pointed, length 0.075–0.10, width 0.10–0.15 mm. Mandibles long, sword-shaped, slightly incurved, the apex pointed; the outer margin strongly incurved beyond the middle; each mandible with a small, reduced tooth beyond the middle, the tooth distance 0.35–0.45 mm, the ratio of the left mandibular tooth distance to mandible length 0.41–0.47. Postmentum short and swollen, length 0.30–0.37, maximum width 0.20–0.25, waist width 0.15 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin with or without a median concavity, the posterior margin straight and without a concavity, length 0.25, width 0.40–0.45 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: The worker is dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule straw-coloured, antennae, labrum and body paler than the head; head and body densely hairy. Body length about 3.5–4.0 mm. Head subsquare, length to the mandibular base 0.60–0.65, maximum width 0.70–0.75 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together, segments 3, 4 and 5 subequal. Postclypeus swollen, about half as long as wide, the anterior margin straight, the posterior margin rounded. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin slightly concave or usually without a concavity, the posterior margin straight, length 0.25, width 0.40 mm. The minor worker resembles the major worker but is slightly smaller.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, antennae light brown, slightly darker at the apex; postclypeus light brown; pronotum slightly paler than the head; legs and abdomen light brown. Head and body densely hairy. Head capsule subcircular, length to the mandibular base 0.66–0.71 mm; fontanelle plate long, white. Eyes subcircular, maximum diameter 0.19–0.20, minimum diameter 0.16–0.17 mm, slightly convex, their distance from the lower margin of the head more than half their maximum diameter, that is, 0.11 mm. Ocelli oval, short diameter 0.06–0.07 mm, distance from the eye 0.04–0.06 mm. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus swollen, width 0.37–0.39 mm, length about half the width or slightly more. Pronotum subtrapezoidal, length 0.39–0.44, width 0.66–0.75 mm, the anterior margin nearly straight and without a concavity, the posterior margin markedly concave in the middle.
